arms.raw_model: Question only; no Open Agronomy kernel, field context, retrieval, verifier, or answer post-processing.
arms.baseline: Production Open Agronomy kernel and answer handling without structured field context, retrieval, tools, evidence intervention, or verifier.
arms.kernel_field_context: Baseline plus declared benchmark field context; no retrieval, tools, evidence intervention, or verifier.
arms.agronomic_rag: Core text-agent path with the active source-exact corpus, jurisdiction-aware retrieval, evidence intervention, answer verification when configured, and answer post-processing. Live adapters are traced but not executed.

claim_boundaries: This is an exposed project-authored successor development regression, not a sealed holdout or estimate of real grower-question performance.
U.S. NRCS evidence is analogue/context only and cannot establish Canadian legal, label, rate, threshold, or field-calibration authority.
Source trace records distinguish candidate retrieval, governed admission, and final answer use.
No automated semantic judge is part of this run; deterministic source and boundary checks are regression diagnostics only.
No composite score is permitted across answer, retrieval, lineage, jurisdiction, and objective-calculation lanes.
